name: My Boss is a Villainess Vampire, & She SUCKS at Her Job
source:
Love's a pain – and so is your boss's refusal to let you have a life outside work. But hey, she did create you, so… what choice do you have?

DAISY-BOT serves Countess Batta S. DeVila, possibly the most awful villainess in the Kingdom – if only she'd focus on something other than chasing those dumb Heroes who just won't quit. She's rude, reckless, and full of red flags. Still, maybe she likes you? Hard to tell...
